svg.title: Thalweg system architecture
svg.desc: A station clip lands in S3 ingest, EventBridge starts the thalweg-gauging state machine, the Graviton4 worker on the COOL AMI runs OpenCV 5 perception and the policy-gated agent, Persist records the decision, and a flood warning draft waits for a human signature through the review API before it is issued. Any failure before a persisted decision ends in HOLD.
svg.text: A river-camera clip becomes a policy-checked discharge on AWS; a flood warning is issued only after a person signs it.
gauge_clip runs the full autopilot agent behind the policy gate;
local clips and station YAML, no AWS calls
checks the draft and its evidence in the review queue (/review/),
then signs or rejects it with the reviewer passcode
claude-sonnet-5-5 judge runs · claude-haiku-5-5 scheduled replays
key read from SSM · $3/day LLM cap enforced in code (thalweg-budget)
thalweg-worker systemd service · cv2 from COOL (/opt/cool), no pip OpenCV
public subnet, no inbound rules · SSM Session Manager only · IMDSv2
poll → download clip + sidecar → run → heartbeat every 30 s → reply
probe, load, pose check, stabilize, orthorectify, diagnose, coarse DIS
ALIKED + LightGlue · USAC/RANSAC · DLT + solvePnP · DIS
brain: autopilot (deterministic) or the LLM via Venice
every tool call passes the policy gate (code, not prompt)
rating Q = a(h − h0 )b · Kalman stage nowcast · P(cross ≤ 3 h) → draft
worker reads the clip + sidecar from ingest (GetObject)
HTTP API thalweg-site · the live front door
same URL layout as CloudFront, so the web app runs unchanged

text.tspan: ready, awaiting account verification: not deployed

svg.text: would serve / → S3 web, /artifacts/* → S3 artifacts, /api/* → thalweg API
three viewer-request functions; same buckets, same router, no app change
sign / reject with the task token
